resources.string: Securely pairs this protection app with NIKNOLIG. The local security status is only sent after your approval and only to the paired device.
This device is not registered. Sign in to register it.
Signing in and registering the device…
This device was revoked and removed locally.
Registration needs your account. The password and sign-in token are not stored.
Your code: %1$s\nValid for 2 minutes. Enter it on the other device. The other device must run the respective other app.
Device “%1$s” connected. Check that both devices show this comparison code: %2$s
Does “%1$s” show the same code %2$s? Confirm only if both codes match.
The code expired. Create a new one.
All connections and sessions of this device are ended on the server. Registering again is required afterwards.
The device connection is disabled in this build until the written security approval (SecurityChain-P0) exists.
No HTTPS backend is configured. This feature is unavailable without a backend.
Account sign-in is not configured in this build.
Please enter the code from the other device.
Timed out. Check your connection and try again.
No connection to the server. You are offline or the server is unreachable.
The session was rejected or revoked. Register the device again if needed.
Permission is missing, for example a grant from the other device.
Not found: wrong or expired code, or no longer available.
The action does not fit the current state, for example a connection already exists.
Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
Unexpected server response. The action was not performed.
This device cannot create a secure device key.
Scan the other device\'s QR code
Pairing QR code. It contains the same one-time code shown above it.
This QR code is not a valid pairing code from the other NIKNOLIG app.
The QR scanner is not available on this device (Google Play services required). Enter the code manually.
A nearby device offers pairing: %1$s. Scan its QR code or enter the code it shows. Discovery does not replace confirmation on both devices.
Device key: Ed25519 in the Android Keystore (non-exportable).
Your account is not enabled for this app (app_area claim missing). Contact support.
Your account belongs to the other app. Sign in with the matching account.
The sign-in token has expired. Please sign in again.
